correctness.rationale: The radial generator under y=nF_(t/n) is κ[y(1-y/n)f''+(1-y)f']. The bounded-at-zero hitting ODE gives (k+1)^2 a_(k+1)=[s/κ+k+k(k-1)/n] a_k, so positivity and strict coefficient decay for k>=3 prove the Laplace ordering. Differentiation at zero yields mean sum z^k/(k k!) prod_(j=1)^(k-2)(1+j/n), whose 1/n correction is C(z)=sum_(k>=3)(k-1)(k-2)z^k/(2k k!). Uniform bounded-coefficient limits give Kummer transform, small-z rescaling yields 1/I_0(2sqrt λ), and a product dominated by K^q with q=λ/H(z) gives the large-z Exp(1) clock. Independent exact rational coefficient inequalities tested n=3,5,10,40 and k=3..13.
